basis: Alice runs glass_table -> curtain at 2.74 m. She pinches the key off the 0.715 m tabletop at t=0.8 while stooped almost double (bend 1.1 rad under a 2.80 m vault), turns at t=2.2 and crosses the 4.9 m to the low curtain at about 1.0 m/s bent double, then gets down on her side at t=6.4 and brings one eye to the open doorway. Lying, her foot anchor is (7.28, -1.545) and her 2.74 m body runs head-first to (9.65, -2.92) at the little door in the west wall (inner face Z -3.281); her shoulder presses the wall at the door, which is the intended contact, and nothing else in the hall is inside her swept volume. Her height for sh067 is the continuity_plan size_chain figure, so her eye is about 0.055 m across against the door's 0.26 m opening - the composition sh067 line that makes the door narrower than her eye is the open DEF-p6-continuity-ep01-002 finding-b and is not staged.
warnings: sh066: the lens is set on the -Z side of her crossing so screen-right points +X-ish and her travel reads frame-left, which is what composition sh066 requires; on the tile-2 side of the axis her travel would read frame-right. She passes about 1.2 m from the lens and crosses it as a hand, a knee and a shoulder, never a whole figure.

Alice's height for sh067 comes from continuity_plan size_chain (2.74 m); composition sh067's 'the door is now narrower than her eye is wide' is the open DEF-p6-continuity-ep01-002 finding-b and no number in this plan depends on it.

She is rolled onto her side (body_roll -1.4 rad from face-up) so her eye, not her face, is at the doorway; her shoulder touching the west wall face at the little door is a deliberate contact, everything else clears by more than 0.15 m.

sh066's lens is re-set perpendicular to her crossing at 1.6 m so she really does cross the frame right-to-left as a fragment between t=2.6 and t=4.2; the key pinch at t=0.8 happens off this frame, which is consistent with composition sh066 describing only the crossing fragments.

sh067's lens is moved onto the wall side and looks along the west wall at her head from 2.36 m: her eye is at the doorway facing the wall, so a lens out in the hall (the tile-9 sight line) sees only the back of her head. Even so a primitive head cannot carry an eye-scale close - her whole head fills about half the frame, which is the most the whitebox can say about 'one enormous eye'.
